expanded_name: Cross-View Latent Reconstruction Adapter for X-VLA

closest_external_prior.name: WristWorld
closest_external_prior.relationship: prior extension at the anchor-to-wrist problem axis; latent reconstruction and frozen-VLA token insertion replace 4D pixel-video generation

panel.instruction: open the middle drawer of the cabinet
pick up the alphabet soup and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl on the ramekin and place it on the plate

data_split.target_source: clean wrist-view Florence2 tokens from the same synchronized demonstration frame

scientific_method.core_mechanism: predict the missing 50x1024 wrist-view Florence2 token block from current agent-view tokens, language, and proprioception, then replace only the wrist slice of X-VLA aux_visual_inputs during wrist dropout
scientific_method.primary_objective: mean squared error between predicted and clean wrist-view Florence2 tokens
scientific_method.clean_bypass: when missing_indicator is zero, return the original aux_visual_inputs tensor unchanged

low_compute_parameterization.standard_lora_omission_reason: X-VLA remains frozen and generic policy adaptation does not test cross-view wrist-latent reconstruction.

comparators.BASE: frozen X-VLA with the existing black-pixel wrist-dropout input
comparators.PRIOR: MECHANISM_FAITHFUL_RL4IL_LOCAL_PORT reserved for a separately frozen closed-loop comparison if Stage 0 passes
comparators.KEY_ABLATION: CVLR_NO_RECONSTRUCTION, identical dropout insertion path with an all-zero wrist latent block
comparators.SIMPLE_CONTROL: AWF_DETERMINISTIC_AGENT_TOKEN_FILL, copy current agent-view tokens into the wrist latent block

training_budget.checkpoint_selection: final frozen step only; no validation selection

reconstruction_thresholds.description: Full must reduce validation MSE by at least 5% relative to the better of zero-fill and deterministic AWF overall, and beat both controls on at least two of three tasks.

action_effect_thresholds.meaningful_effect_rule: at least one of the three separately defined thresholds must pass; a merely nonzero floating-point delta is insufficient

decision_rule.CVLR_XVLA_STAGE0_PASS: all validity, reconstruction, action-effect, clean-bypass, and semantic-aware safety gates pass
decision_rule.CVLR_XVLA_STAGE0_DATA_OR_SUPERVISION_FAI: clean latent targets, split integrity, or required contrast is invalid
decision_rule.CVLR_XVLA_STAGE0_KEY_COMPONENT_NOT_USEFU: valid execution and safe actions, but reconstruction does not meaningfully beat both controls or full is action-indistinguishable from no-reconstruction
decision_rule.CVLR_XVLA_STAGE0_DESIGN_FAILURE: integration is valid but clean bypass, semantic-aware action safety, or action validity fails

automatic_progression.on_pass: freeze a separate bounded paired CVLR Stage A contract and launch it
automatic_progression.on_implementation_failure: allow exactly one narrow repair and rerun this unchanged frozen stage
automatic_progression.on_key_component_not_useful: archive CVLR honestly without Stage A
automatic_progression.on_design_failure: archive CVLR honestly without Stage A
